description: Open-set machine learning primitives. ML.Cluster: online cosine clustering with confidence-gated EMA centroid updates plus batch agglomerative re-clustering (absolute link threshold, k emerges naturally); labels are session-local and never stable identifiers. ML.Detect: per-element motion watching (freeze and jump signatures against a frozen healthy reference), detection by movement complementary to the clusterer's detection by position.

subPlugins.description: Open-set clustering. Online Clusterer assigns each embedding to the nearest cosine centroid (new profile above assign_thr, EMA update below update_thr) and raises a wire-compatible Alert Bus alarm when a new regime appears; a recluster token runs the batch agglomerative merge over the bounded history to recover from online over-segmentation.

Per-element detection signatures. Motion Watch freezes a healthy per-element step reference during warmup, then flags an abnormally large step (REGIME_JUMP) or a rolling-path collapse (REGIME_FREEZE) per vector component, rising-edge latched with hysteresis; alarms are wire-compatible with the Alert Bus and a _rebaseline control token re-enters warmup on demand.
